core_obligations: Adjunction half (proof lines 4183-4215): a_*a^-1F is the equalizer of a_{0,*}a_0^-1F and a_{1,*}a_1^-1F; the push-pull rewrite makes both SheafHom(F(K_i)^#, F); the hypercovering coequalizer F(K_1)^# -> F(K_0)^# -> * then yields F = a_*a^-1F because SheafHom(-, F) sends coequalizers to equalizers.

Essential image (lines 4217-4351): for cartesian G, the descent-data formulation (footnoted in full) is transported to a simplicial-representable K; the cosk_1 sk_1 replacement uses faithfulness of pullback along the covering {U_2 -> (cosk_1 sk_1 U)_2} (the one flagged 'small detail omitted'); the monomorphism (d_0^2,d_1^2,d_2^2): U_2 -> U_1^3 and the section-diagram identify the cocycle condition on U_2 with a glueing condition on U_0 x U_0; sites-lemma-glue-maps gives alpha' over U_0 x U_0, its cocycle condition holds on U_0^3 by surjectivity, and the mapping-property lemma finishes.
proof_roadmap: Reduction to simplicially representable K via a good site.
Cosk_1 replacement, glueing maps, mapping-property close.
